estimate_kind: Monthly budget, not invoiced or measured spend
assumptions: APIM is disabled and its capacity budget is zero. Prior accrued APIM charges remain payable; this is the steady-state budget after removal.
Current deployment: private-only Premium registry, eight private endpoints and thirteen private DNS zones. Builds use disposable private Linux VMs.
Jumpbox runs 20 hours/month; its disk, NAT gateway and public IP remain allocated all month.
Six Foundry Cosmos autoscale containers stay at their 100 RU/s minimum. Sustained 1000 RU/s on all six adds USD 473.04/month.
Container Apps is charged at active rates for the full month, 0.5 vCPU and 1 GiB. No subscription-shared free grants assumed.
100 GB NAT processing, 100 GB endpoint processing, one million DNS queries and 20 GB inter-region traffic in each direction are budget assumptions.
Cosmos combined storage and continuous backup each assume 10 GB; Log Analytics assumes 10 billable GB beyond any shared free allowance.
Storage, security, build, alert and optional-feature allowances are budget placeholders, not measured usage or sourced unit prices.
Model tokens, hosted runtime and tools retain illustrative workload assumptions. No completed-review count is supplied because measured completions are unavailable.
No taxes, contract discounts, reservations or support plan allocation. Shared state storage is included in the storage allowance. ActualCost reconciliation remains unavailable after HTTP 429.
